what_happened: 9 of 40 adversarial ml transactions were scored below the detection threshold.
why: The classifier relies heavily on deviation_from_avg_amount, amount for this layer, but in these missed cases those features sit within 0.00 standard deviations of normal legitimate traffic — the attack is engineered to look statistically ordinary on exactly the dimensions this layer checks. The model also assigns low learned importance to deviation_from_avg_amount, amount, confirming the classifier isn't weighting these signals meaningfully.
remediation: Run adversarial local-search against the CURRENT model to generate harder boundary-evading variants → retrain → re-evaluate.
